candidates.title: ModServe: Modality- and Stage-Aware Resource Disaggregation for Scalable Multimodal Model Serving
candidates.reason: Production-oriented multimodal serving system with stage disaggregation, modality-aware scheduling, and autoscaling evaluated at 128-GPU scale.

candidates.title: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
candidates.reason: Long-context sparse-attention architecture with deployment evidence and direct attention-compute reduction, relevant to efficient inference.

candidates.title: KVzip: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression with Context Reconstruction
candidates.reason: Query-agnostic reusable KV-cache eviction/compression with substantial cache-size and decoding-latency reductions across long-context workloads.

candidates.title: Teola: Towards End-to-End Optimization of LLM-based Applications
candidates.reason: Fine-grained orchestration framework for end-to-end LLM applications, exposing cross-module pipelining, parallelism, and scheduling opportunities.

candidates.title: A Survey on Inference Optimization Techniques for Mixture of Experts Models
candidates.reason: Focused MoE inference-optimization survey spanning model-, system-, and hardware-level techniques, useful as a lineage map for the MoE survey.
